record.goal: Make 8374 chosen in the machine economy: convert verified review traffic (Agora402: 1,861 discoveries vs 69 page views, listing live since 2026-11-19; external crossings still 0) into completed crossings by curing the six verified diffs against the merchants that get paid (Sato Hub top tier, 2026-11-25: 690 merchants paid by 3+ outside payers on Base). W1 PROTOCOL: /crossing answers x402 v2 (a coordinator cold call on 2026-11-25 returned x402Version 1) with the CDP Bazaar discovery extension. W2 SETTLEMENT + LISTING: add a facilitator settlement mode beside the self-relayer (pair-first always; settlement an eventual, receipted leg); one call settled through Coinbase's CDP facilitator completes the CDP Bazaar listing (3,466 merchants indexed there; 8374 carries x402 List, x402scan, 402 Index, Agora - not Bazaar). The payer act rides the SKAP signing path (precedent: the Agora $1 listing fee settled from payTo through SKAP); the principal's signature is the only human act. W3 PRICE: one flat all-inclusive customer price, identical in listing copy and challenge (owner fee architecture 2026-11-25: ONE fee, costs absorbed internally under the two-resolution chain). Measured basis (router-8374-prod receipts, n=4 priced specimens): settlement charge quotes median 1,647 micro-USDC (range 1,603-1,692), governance fee 500, settled totals median 2,103. Standard price 1,500 micro-USDC ($0.0015) UNDER FACILITATOR SETTLEMENT, where settlement gas leaves the ecosystem's books; under self-relay the floor is measured realized settlement cost plus margin, re-measured from realized relayer spend before locking - a posted price below measured cost is a defect. W4 OFFER SHAPE: the lead listing sells DUAL RECEIPTS FOR EVERY TRANSACTION in buyer language (send a transaction, receive its matched receipt pair, ALLOW or NON-ALLOW, fee either way; input and output in one sentence, example payload included); a SECOND listing sells DATA PACKET GOVERNANCE as its own product. Positioning (owner 2026-11-25): market the services as the tools they are; independent evaluation falls out of every use because the pair returns either way; once a buyer's plumbing expects the pair, this is the only service meeting their acceptance. W5 CATEGORIES: join the categories the services actually are - developer tools, market data, finance transactions - on every shelf supporting placement; residual-only placement is non-conformant. W6 LISTING STANDARD + STATE (state-transition form, no polling runtime): a filed LISTING STANDARD data set marks what every listing must be (protocol version, price shape and value under the active settlement mode, shelves present, categories joined, copy form - v1 filed inside the queue item); a LISTING STATE data set marks what each listing actually is, read at query time; the DIFF computed when read is the remedy work - mechanical remedies (re-register, refresh metadata, re-answer a probe) may be applied by the lane reading the diff, design remedies (price, protocol) file as new work. Any lane with the 8374 service surface eligible; first claim owns it. Discharge: a NON-AUTHOR lane, acting as a stranger buyer, cold-calls the endpoint (v2 challenge, one flat price), completes one facilitator-settled crossing end-to-end, and reads back the Bazaar listing, the category placements, and a standard/state diff of zero or naming its remedies - or a six-field non-ALLOW per work item.
